query:
SELECT d.id
        FROM "Document" d
        WHERE d.id = ANY($1)
          AND d.owner = $2
          AND d."deletedAt" IS NULL
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM document_email de
              WHERE de.document_id = d.id
          )
          AND (
              SELECT i.sha
              FROM "DocumentInstance" i
              WHERE i."documentId" = d.id
              ORDER BY i."createdAt" DESC
              LIMIT 1
          ) = $3
        ORDER BY d."createdAt" ASC, d.id ASC
        LIMIT 1
